utility_environmental_service.label: Utility / environmental service
utility_environmental_service.value: Electric and natural gas distribution, Manhattan district steam service, and investments in electric and natural gas transmission.

regulated_competitive_operating_model.label: Regulated / competitive operating model
regulated_competitive_operating_model.value: Rate-regulated utilities at Con Edison of New York and Orange & Rockland, plus transmission investments through Con Edison Transmission.

generation_fuel_technology_mix_electric_.label: Generation fuel / technology mix [electric generators]
generation_fuel_technology_mix_electric_.value: Natural gas-fired cogeneration at Con Edison of New York produces electricity and district steam.

connections_service_accounts.label: Connections / service accounts
connections_service_accounts.value: Con Edison of New York serves large electric and gas customer bases and Manhattan steam customers. Orange & Rockland serves electric and gas customers.

regulatory_jurisdiction.label: Regulatory jurisdiction
regulatory_jurisdiction.value: New York Public Service Commission and New Jersey Board of Public Utilities oversee utility service. FERC oversees interstate transmission.

electricity_output_generators.label: Electricity output [generators]
electricity_output_generators.value: Con Edison of New York’s own generation supplies a small share of its annual electricity deliveries.

system_peak_demand_electric_networks.label: System peak demand [electric networks]
system_peak_demand_electric_networks.value: Electric demand peaks in summer, with a substantially larger system peak at Con Edison of New York than at Orange & Rockland.

gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.label: Gas network / delivery [gas utilities]
gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.value: Con Edison of New York distributes natural gas in New York City and Westchester County. Orange & Rockland distributes gas in southeastern New York.

steam_irrigation_service.label: Steam / irrigation service
steam_irrigation_service.value: District steam distribution in parts of Manhattan through Con Edison of New York.

notes: The overview’s reference to competitive energy businesses appears to predate the sale of Con Edison’s Clean Energy Businesses.
